bladeScrap: Welded scrap ground to a point. Rudimentary but effective.
pistolCrude: An assembly of technical parts and metal. It fires, most of the time.
rifleMakeshift: Improved range, rough accuracy. Better than nothing in hostile territory.
plasmaLance: An energy crystal focused through a conductor tube. Burns whatever it touches.
tacticalWeapon: A solid build from heavy materials and advanced components.
impulseCannon: Combines special ammunition and advanced technology for devastating damage.
exoticWeapon: The pinnacle of crafting. Requires rare materials and total mastery.
tacticalRifle: Salvaged from abandoned combat gear. More reliable than a makeshift weapon.
tacticalArmor: Tactical component plates welded onto a lightweight frame. Effective in hostile terrain.
jacketPlated: Metal plates sewn into thick fabric. Simple but sturdy.
combatArmor: A reinforced build using premium salvaged materials.
reinforcedArmor: An alloy of rare metals and advanced technology. Resists almost anything.
eliteSuit: The best an artisan can produce. Requires extremely rare materials.
medkit: Heals 30 HP from the station hub. Use it between fights.
medkitAdv: Heals 60 HP and restores 2 stamina from the station hub.
empGrenade: Stuns the enemy for 2 turns. Use from the inventory during combat.
stimulant: Restores 3 stamina from the hub. Made of plants and nutrients.
synthFuel: Grants +2 fuel immediately upon crafting. Unstable but functional.
smokeBomb: Guarantees an escape in combat. Use from the inventory during combat.
dataClassified: Recompiles two batches of ordinary data into high-value information.
rareMetal: Refines raw metals into a rare alloy usable in advanced crafting.
voidRegulator: Stabilizes an unstable energy flow into an exploitable signal. No merchant knows how to make one — or dares admit it.
ghostNavChip: Calculates routes official maps ignore. A cross between classified data and components found in no catalog.
annealedAlloy: A precise heat treatment only a well-equipped workshop can reliably reproduce.
